value.rationale: The natural finite-memory approximations of a zero-entropy uniquely ergodic Fibonacci system have an explicit scale-dependent entropy approximation cost. The exact staircase and full continuum of first-order constants show no single normalized 1/n approximation constant exists, despite convergence h_n→0. Quantifying the full unavoidable envelope is meaningful for SFT-cover entropy-stability estimates and finite-symbol numerical approximations, and cannot be read from the zero-entropy fact alone. This is a modest but complete exact natural invariant, not a general entropy theorem or a claim about all Sturmian languages.
